_about: Every tuning number for the web game.

clearing._about: The starting clearing (tiles), centred in the forest. Small on purpose: the starter kit and the first few days of buying fill it, so Room to grow matters.

start._about: A new garden opens on a little grotto around the spring: its streams, scenery along its edge (visual only), and the opening's seed tin (Content/opening.json) on a free tile within tin.near of the spring.

garden._about: The garden. Plants (Content/plants.json) grow through stages (seed, sprout, bud, bloom, ready) over growHours on their own school's soil, timed from timestamps so time away counts. soil: growth speed on the plant's own soil (preferred), on plain soil (plain); on another school's soil it can't be planted at all. stages: the share of growth at which sprout, bud and bloom begin; ready at 1. Per plant (plants): growHours, yield (produce per harvest), seeds [packets always returned, chance of one more], sell (coins per produce). Every plant leaves its tile when it's harvested. Seed packets and their odds: packets. amendments: the Store's daily soil stock. sellByRarity: the price of anything else in the Bag that can be sold (foraged finds). startCoins: coins in a new garden. starterSet: what the opening's tin holds: Common seeds of the chosen school and of the runner-up, and a few amendments of each. morning: after minAwayHours of real time away a card sums up what's ready; at most one surprise per local day, with surpriseChance, chosen by weight among the kinds possible right now.

soil._wrong: A plant whose tile was overtaken by another school's soil keeps growing, at this speed.

levels._about: Soil matures one level each night it holds (tuning.tides), 1 to max. On a plant's own soil each level above 1 adds speedPerLevel to its speed, and from yieldAt it gives +1 produce. Higher levels look more strongly of their school.

amendments._about: Soil amendments are scarce: the Store stocks perDay school amendments each local day (one bag each, chosen from the garden seed and the day) at `price`; Garden loam (back to plain) is always there at plainPrice. Other sources: the opening's tin, and the soil patches Room to grow uncovers.

morning._kinds: selfSeed: a seedling next to a blooming plant. gift: a befriended visitor leaves its gift seeds in the Bag. rareColour: a ready plant with a colour variety turns out to be that variety (its harvest gives the variety's produce and seeds).

companions._about: Each plant has a few neighbour rules (Content/plants.json companions): when a named plant grows in one of its 8 neighbouring tiles (at any stage), a speed rule makes it grow speed times as fast and a yield rule adds `yield` produce to its harvest. Several speed rules don't stack beyond maxSpeed. A rule is discovered (and shown on the plant's Field Guide page) the first time it is active at a harvest.

decor._about: What decor does, by kind (Content/cosmetics.json kind; relic ornaments are kind ornament). beauty: added to the garden's beauty while placed. ground: drawn flat under everything (paths). holdsPlant: a plant can be planted on it (a raised bed), and gets `yield` extra produce. glow: lights up at dusk and night. Ornaments (Content/relics.json): plants of the relic's school within `radius` tiles (a 3x3) grow schoolSpeed times as fast.

beauty._about: Garden beauty, never shown as a number: variety x each distinct plant growing in the garden, blooming x each plant in bloom or ready, plus every placed decor's beauty (decor.kinds). It shows as a named tier with a leaf meter. The best tier ever reached opens Store items (plants' `beauty`, listings' 'Needs beauty tier') and never relocks.

varieties._about: Colour varieties (plants.json varieties: a hue, and leaves to recolour the greens too). Cross-pollination: harvesting a plant while a plant of the same family (the same kind counts) blooms in one of its 8 neighbours gives, with `chance`, one seed packet of one of its varieties (one not yet found first). Kept hidden from the player. A variety grows like its plant and breeds true; its produce sells for sellMult times as much and has its own Field Guide entry.

collections._about: Field Guide collections: harvest every plant of a school (its seed plants and its gift plant) once to complete it; the reward is that school's relic ornament (Content/relics.json) and `coins`.

orders._about: Daily orders at the Old Log (requests of kind 'order'): perDay of them each local day, picked (deterministically, from the garden seed and the day) from the orders whose produce comes from plants the player has already harvested.

packets._about: Seed packets are blind pulls: each school sells Common, Uncommon and Rare seeds. Planting one picks a plant from that school's seed plants (plants.json source 'seeds'): first a tier by the packet's `odds` (never a sure thing), then evenly among that school's plants of the tier (a tier with none steps down). The plant shows only as a seedling until it reaches its bud. Harvests return seeds of the plant's own school and tier (seeds per plant in plants), so rare plants give rare seeds. `price` in the Store; `beauty`: the beauty tier that puts that tier of seeds on the shelf. Gift plants and colour varieties keep their own named packets.

forage._about: The foraging patch: a few plain finds turn up by chance on the clearing's outer ring, by the treeline. Every slotMinutes of game time (offline included, at most maxCatchUpSlots), each slot has `chance` of one find, up to `max` waiting at once. Which slot gets a find, the tile and the item are hashed from the garden seed and the slot, so it's deterministic. Tap to pick. Set enabled false to turn the patch off.

expansion._about: Room to grow (Store): each purchase clears the trees on one side the player chooses (top, bottom, left or right), sideTiles rows deep. The new ground isn't empty: each purchase uncovers a patch of wildSoilTiles tiles of one school's soil along the old edge (a different school each time, in an order shuffled by the garden seed) and, beside it, that school's wild feature. Features stay where they grew (they can't be moved or bought) and add their beauty to the garden. The foraging patch moves out with the treeline on its own.

spore.name: Mossy stone
spore.text: A stone furred with moss. The ground around it stays damp and dark.

glow.name: Glowing flowers
glow.text: Wild flowers that glow faintly after dark. The soil here shines a little too.

bloom.name: Wild flowers
bloom.text: A clump of flowers no one planted. Petals have fallen into the soil for years.

verdure.name: Old oak
verdure.text: An oak older than the clearing. Leaf mould lies thick beneath it.

shimmer.name: Crystal outcrop
shimmer.text: Crystals pushing up through the earth. The ground glitters around them.

spirit.name: Misty pine
spirit.text: A tall pine that keeps a little mist around its roots.

offerings._about: The Old Log board and Store (Resources/Content/requests.json, cosmetics.json from design/Undergrowth_Offerings.xlsx). Recolouring a placed decor prop costs recolorCost (0 = free).

visitors._about: Visitors (Content/visitors.json): forest animals drawn by particular plants blooming in the garden, in their time window. Every checkMinutes of game time (offline catch-up included, up to maxCatchUpDays) each visitor's interest rises by interest.gain while every plant it likes is blooming (in bloom or ready) somewhere in the garden, and falls by interest.decay when not. Stages: signs (in its time window, tracks appear beside the plants it likes, chance tracks.chance per check, fading after tracks.hours), clues (tapping tracks reads a clue naming one of its preferences the player doesn't know yet, recorded on its Field Guide page), present (in its window it comes with presence.chance per check, staying presence.minutes, at most presence.perDay a day). Tapping a present visitor befriends it: it leaves its gift seeds at once, comes more often (befriended*), and now and then leaves more on a morning (the morning card's gift surprise). Each check's random choices are seeded from the garden, the visitor and the check's time, so it's deterministic.

naming._about: A garden left unnamed takes its name from its most common soil (Content/nameParts.json).

clock._about: Real local time of day: the four lighting states and the visitors' time windows (dawn, day, dusk, night).

canopy._about: Tree shadows from design/shadow_overlay_v2.webp (processed by tools/gen_canopy.py into img/canopy.png: alpha = sunlight, texelsPerPx image px per art px, drawn smooth at up to maxRes buffer px per art px). Layer 1 at full strength, layer 2 offset/scaled/flipped and added at secondAlpha so the flecks never repeat on a grid, and a large soft region layer that lifts the shade in some areas (clearings).

lighting._about: Per state; values blend smoothly across clock.transitionMinutes around each boundary. shade/light = canopy shade and sunlight-patch strength (light is drawn with canopy.lightBlend); glow = warm glow on the brightest centres; shafts = strength of the diagonal light beams; classic = the earlier look's values (Debug: Sunlight classic). ambient multiplies the whole scene.

softCorners._about: Soil tiles clip a corner where neither tile beside it has the same soil: the corner is rounded off with a circle of `radius` art pixels, fading out over the last `soft` pixels in `steps` alpha steps.

soilDetails._about: Small things growing on school soil (detail.<school>.a/b): each soil tile shows one with chance[level - 1], so older soil is busier. Hidden under plants, decor and debris.

water._about: The spring (centre of the clearing) and its streams. A new garden's streams take riverTiles water tiles (not counting the spring), in at least minStreams streams: either leaving the spring in different directions or forking, meandering at random (keepDirection: chance to carry straight on). Streams never touch each other except where they fork, so they stay distinct. dig: digging an empty tile next to water turns it into water (its soil is lost) for cost + step x tiles dug so far.
water._levels: The water's level each day from its power (weather + moon): the first level whose `below` the power is under. inset: how many pixels of bank show between the water and dry land (negative: it spills over the bank). cross: each night, the chance for soil on a bank to be carried across the stream.

weather._about: Each local day has weather, deterministic from the garden seed: it repeats yesterday's with `persistence`, otherwise it's drawn by `weight`. The forecast shows today and tomorrow. `power` is how hard that day's weather drives the water at night.

moon._about: The real moon's phase on each local day (synodic month from a known new moon). Its power adds to the weather's: the water runs highest when a storm meets a full moon.

tides._about: Each night (local midnight) soil spreads from the banks (tiles touching water), with power = that day's weather power + moon power. Each bank tile with soil may spread it along the bank to a neighbouring bank tile (chance alongBank x power) and inland to any open neighbour (chance inland x power), both capped at cap. Soil never spreads through the water: a corner step is only allowed when neither tile beside it is water. At a High or Flood level (water.levels: cross) it may also carry across the stream to the far bank. A tile resists by its maturity, and more with a plant growing on it: it holds with chance resist / (resist + hold), where resist = maturity (0 for plain) + plantHold. Tiles that held their soil through the night mature by one level, up to maxLevel. Catch-up covers at most maxNights.
